title: Manage Services and Configuration Changes
objective: Declare service state and connect configuration changes to safe restarts.

sourceAlignment.title: Getting started with Ansible 12 - Managing Services
sourceAlignment.creator: LearnLinuxTV
sourceAlignment.note: English captions informed topic alignment and timestamps. Lesson prose and exercises are original Code Forge material.

paragraphs: The service module declares whether a service should be started, stopped, restarted, and enabled. Starting an already-running service should not create a change.
Configuration edits should use a file-aware module such as template, copy, or lineinfile. Each edit must be narrow enough to rerun without appending duplicate lines.
A restart belongs in a handler when it is required only after configuration changes. Handlers coalesce repeated notifications and run after the play’s normal tasks.
explanation.rule: Notify a restart from the configuration task; do not restart a healthy service on every run.

examples.title: Working design or automation artifact
examples.code:
- name: Ensure nginx is running
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: nginx
    state: started
    enabled: true
examples.note: Read the structure, predict its effect, then adapt it in the assignment and terminal mission.

assignment.title: Declare Service State
assignment.brief: Ensure nginx is started and enabled.
requirements: Include every named safety or behavior requirement.
assignment.solutionCode:

    name: nginx

    enabled: true
